policy.core: exact T1 source tables, centering, weights and reliability; reproduce byte hashes first
policy.ko_centering: none: matched-control contrasts; no panel mean that would erase singleton STAT6
policy.ko_estimates: use existing per-context shrunk effects and measured masks; no new shrinkage after pooling
policy.ko_qc: exact singleton labels, matched controls, existing min_cells=10, finite nonnegative SE; no own-RNA-sign gate
policy.pooling: within each study and lineage, reliability-weighted average over contexts using n/(n+100); keep identities and consumption receipts
policy.ko_study_reliability: maximum contributing context reliability per target and gene; never summed over replicates
policy.rationale: fixed quarter-weight prior for an unvalidated distinct loss-of-function mechanism; not optimized against scores or new effects
policy.combination: add KO numerator and denominator to pre-amplitude CRISPRi mixture; then original amplitude and cis once
policy.crispr_a: excluded from this loss-of-function estimator; no automatic sign reversal
policy.off_panel: retained in derived bank and ESM2 views; no false same-target prediction contribution

precedents: S-010: no new pseudo-replicate votes; T1 control preserved
S-011: singleton KO is not centered to zero
S-012: CRISPRi panel centering unchanged; no all-target common substitution
S-006: uncentered KO common burden remains a risk, bounded by fixed weak study votes
technical_abort: missing required KO context or chunk
nonfinite values or negative SE on measured pairs
scientific_status: exploratory, no promotion; independent validation may flag failure but no weight tuning
